title: Use AKS-managed Microsoft Entra authentication
description: Integrate cluster sign-in with AKS-managed Microsoft Entra ID. Use group-based access, Conditional Access where applicable, and kubelogin; do not use the retired legacy Entra integration.

title: Choose and enforce least-privilege cluster authorization
description: Choose Azure RBAC for Kubernetes authorization or Kubernetes RBAC with Microsoft Entra groups. Distinguish Azure management-plane roles from in-cluster data-plane permissions, avoid routine cluster-admin access, and test denied operations.

documentation.title: Microsoft Entra ID with Kubernetes RBAC
Microsoft Entra ID authorization for the Kubernetes API

title: Pull images from ACR using the kubelet managed identity
description: Grant the kubelet identity AcrPull for a non-ABAC registry. For an ABAC-enabled registry, assign Container Registry Repository Reader at the appropriate scope; --attach-acr is not supported in that permissions mode. Keep the ACR admin account disabled.

documentation.title: Pull images from ACR using the kubelet managed identity

title: Use managed identities for cluster infrastructure
description: Use managed identities rather than service principals for the AKS control plane and kubelet. Scope permissions separately; workloads must use their own federated identities, not inherit node permissions.

documentation.title: Use managed identities for cluster infrastructure

title: Limit access to admin kubeconfig (get-credentials --admin)
description: To limit who can get that Kubernetes configuration (kubeconfig) information and to limit the permissions they then have, you can use Azure role-based access control (Azure RBAC).

documentation.title: Use Azure RBAC to define access to the Kubernetes configuration file

title: Use kubelogin and federated identities for automation
description: Use the supported kubelogin authentication flow for Microsoft Entra-integrated clusters. Prefer workload identity federation or managed identity for CI/CD instead of long-lived client secrets, and validate noninteractive access from the deployment runner.

documentation.title: Use kubelogin and federated identities for automation

title: Disable local accounts and test emergency access
description: Disable local Kubernetes accounts on Microsoft Entra-integrated clusters. Document an audited emergency-access procedure, restrict who can change the setting, and rotate previously issued cluster certificates where required.

documentation.title: Disable local accounts and test emergency access

title: Use time-bound privileged access where required
description: Use Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management for eligible group or Azure role assignments. Require approval and MFA for privileged operations, log activation, and test access expiry.

documentation.title: Use time-bound privileged access where required

title: Pre-create a kubelet identity when role assignment requires it
description: Use a pre-created user-assigned kubelet identity when permissions must exist before cluster creation. Grant only the registry and infrastructure access it needs; account for role-assignment propagation delays.

documentation.title: Pre-create a kubelet identity when role assignment requires it

title: Apply Conditional Access to interactive cluster access
description: Evaluate Microsoft Entra Conditional Access for administrators, including MFA and device requirements. Test the chosen kubelogin flow and document separate controls for workload and automation identities.

documentation.title: Apply Conditional Access to interactive cluster access
